title: This Desert Lizard Drinks With Its Feet. Here's How the Water Reaches Its Mouth
subject: thorny devil

scenes.text: This desert lizard drinks through its skin. How does the water reach its mouth?
The thorny devil has tiny channels between its spiky scales.
Touch water with any limb, or even damp sand, and the channels soak it up like a straw.
That's capillary action. The water crawls along the skin until it reaches the lizard's mouth.
It doesn't need a puddle. Damp desert sand is its main water source, and morning dew works too.
Add the fake head on its neck, and this lizard is built from tricks. So yes: it drinks with its feet.
